// REQ: LANG-1271 LANG-1272 LANG-1273
import ballerina/io;

type Person record {| string name; int age; |};

@display {label: "Greeter"}
public function main() returns error? {
    Person p = {name: "Ann", age: 30};
    string greeting = string `Hello, ${p.name}!`;
    int[] numbers = [1, 2, 0x1F];
    foreach int n in numbers {
        if n > 1 && true { io:println(greeting, n, 3.14); }
    }
    check io:fileWriteString("out.txt", greeting);
}
